notes.title: Platformer v0.2.1.0 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/418cc4b19b0397a131902fd017585553da01b6e6.png[/img]

[h1]What's been changed and added to the game?[/h1]
The map is now larger with several new biomes like the jungle, ocean biome, lava caverns, cloud biome and space. Find new treasure, enemies, ore, crafting recipes, less lag, and more fun in Platformer 0.2.1.0!

[h1](!)Character and Map Reset(!)[/h1]
As stated in pre-release, this update will wipe character and map data before version 0.2.1.0.

[h1]New Biomes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Discover the jungle
[*] Venture into the depths of the ocean
[*] Dig deep down into the lava caverns
[*] Rise into the clouds
[*] Leave the atmosphere and touch the stars
[/list]
[h1]New Furniture[/h1]
[list]
[*] Chests
[*] Beds
[*] Tables
[*] Chairs
[*] Lamps
[*] Doors
[*] Small table lamps
[*] Decorative furniture
[/list]
[h1]New Equipment[/h1]
[list]
[*] 14 new enemies and creatures
[*] Platinum ore, equipment, and tools
[*] Raptor equipment set
[*] Wizard equipment set
[*] Diving Helmet
[*] New trinkets
[*] Iron arrows
[*] Grenades
[/list]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lava
[*] New blocks
[*] New crafting recipes
[*] Added gemstones
[*] Ability to place some objects on tables
[*] Glowreed plants that grow from seeds
[*] Palm and Jungle trees
[*] Added paintings that can be found in the world
[*] Food now heals over time, potions heal instantly
[*] Colored light
[*] Revamped lighting system
[*] Status effects / buffs / debuffs
[*] Place some objects on tables
[*] New hairstyles and eyes
[*] New achievements
[*] Improved enemy AI
[*] New music and sound effects
[*] Enemy banners now drop after killing enough of certain enemies
[*] Auto-dig feature for pickaxes that can be toggled with L CTRL
[*] Updated some in-game graphics
[*] Rewrote saving/loading system
[*] Adjusted player movement dynamics
[*] Overall UI improvements
[*] Optimized world generation and loading speeds
[*] An abundance of bugs and other issues have been fixed
[*] Multiplayer fixes and speed enhancements
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] When a player walks across a world, it will lag slightly while loading new chunks
[*] If lava light doesn't go away for players who are joined to a server, it should reset once it's offscreen
[*] During world creation, it can take a minute or two to settle certain elements
[*] Players who join a server may experience some rubber banding
[*] Glowreeds sometimes land in odd ways when thrown
[/list]
[h1]Updated Official Guidebook[/h1]
View the updated Platformer guidebook information on our [url=https://3elementsofficial.com/PlatformerGuide]website[/url]

[h2]Feeling like there is a limited amount of content?[/h2]
[h3]You're right! it's early access![/h3]
A lot more content is coming soon, follow us on Steam for future updates.

notes.title: The Official Platformer Guidebook is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/67eb33c921f610d0daa09337551d8abfb6a2e630.png[/img]
[h2]The Official Platformer Guidebook is now available![/h2]

[h3]You can find the Platformer guidebook at: [url=https://3elementsofficial.com]3ElementsOfficial.com[/url][/h3]
In the guidebook, you can explore the item and monster Index, and you can discover crafting recipes that are hidden in Platformer to help you create your favorite weapons and ammunition.
The 'How to play' section explains gameplay basics and controls.

New content will appear in the guidebook as it gets added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/7fbd0a5915ccd8622a02bf21e59d5b1557716f0d.png[/img]

Not sure what you can make in Platformer?
Want to know if you missed something?
Take a look at the guidebook to reveal spoilers about the game.
[list]
[*] View the Monster Index to see what kind of monsters exist
[*] Browse the Item Index or scroll through the Crafting Recipes page
[*] What's is a "Secret Blueprint" anyway?
[/list]
Browse the guidebook completely ad-free!
Did you know you can turn off gore in the options window?
View the How to Play page and read up on the controls and how the game is played.

Feeling like there is a limited amount of content?
You're right! it's early access!

More content is coming soon, follow us on Steam for future updates.

notes.title: V0.1.34 Trinkets, Achievements and Boss Monsters Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/418cc4b19b0397a131902fd017585553da01b6e6.png[/img]

[h1]V0.1.34 Trinkets, Achievements and Boss Monsters Update[/h1]
We are releasing a handful of new content and bugfixes!

[h3]Achievements were added![/h3]
You can now start earning achievements, more will be added over time.

[h3]You can now vertically scale walls with ladders![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/48b55b6d1b846eb3dd09718141406e099422ec45.png[/img]

[h2]What was fixed and added to the game?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new intro BGM
[*] Added new biome BGMs
[*] Added various trinkets
[*] Added boss events
[*] Added achievements
[*] Added more weapons
[*] Added new crafting recipes
[*] Added the bucket
[*] Added more decorative furniture
[*] Added snow biome
[*] Added pine trees
[*] Added statues
[*] Added ladders
[*] Added a handful of new monsters
[*] Improved server join speed
[*] Flowers and berries now grow in grass
[*] Upgraded light system
[*] Torches now emit more light
[*] Added more caves
[*] Optimized world deletion
[*] Adjusted parallax background effect
[*] Fixed many major and minor bugs
[*] Shift click will now auto-deposit items
[*] Stack splitting is now supported with right click
[*] Improved enemy AI
[/list]

[h2]Expected Gameplay Issues:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Using Hamachi may work better in multi-player for some users
[*] Background tiles occasionally leave left over pixels, reloading the map will temporarily fix it
[*] There are a few bugs in multi-player so don't be surprised if small problems occur
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/733f7218fb0cb7bc7c85c9c89fbd9db32fe108b2.png[/img]

[h3]Feeling like there is a limited amount of content?[/h3]
You're right! it's early access!

More content is coming soon, follow us on Steam for future updates.
